objects.definition: typedef unsigned long RtAudioFormat;
objects.description: Bitmask type for audio sample data formats used by RtAudio streams (e.g., RTAUDIO_SINT16, RTAUDIO_FLOAT32). Values are in host byte order; constants are defined in this header.

objects.definition: typedef unsigned int RtAudioStreamFlags;
objects.description: Bitmask type of flags controlling stream behavior (non-interleaved, minimize latency, hog device, schedule realtime, ALSA default, JACK don't connect).

objects.definition: typedef unsigned int RtAudioStreamStatus;
objects.description: Bitmask type indicating stream over/underflow status passed to callbacks (RTAUDIO_INPUT_OVERFLOW, RTAUDIO_OUTPUT_UNDERFLOW).

objects.definition:
typedef std::function<int(void* outputBuffer, void* inputBuffer,
                          unsigned int nFrames,
                          double streamTime,
                          RtAudioStreamStatus status,
                          void* userData)> RtAudioCallback;
objects.description: C++ callback function type invoked by RtAudio to process audio I/O. Returns 0 to continue, 1 to stop/drain, 2 to abort.

objects.definition:
enum RtAudioErrorType {
  RTAUDIO_NO_ERROR = 0,
  RTAUDIO_WARNING,
  RTAUDIO_UNKNOWN_ERROR,
  RTAUDIO_NO_DEVICES_FOUND,
  RTAUDIO_INVALID_DEVICE,
  RTAUDIO_DEVICE_DISCONNECT,
  RTAUDIO_MEMORY_ERROR,
  RTAUDIO_INVALID_PARAMETER,
  RTAUDIO_INVALID_USE,
  RTAUDIO_DRIVER_ERROR,
  RTAUDIO_SYSTEM_ERROR,
  RTAUDIO_THREAD_ERROR
};
objects.description: Enumeration of RtAudio error codes used as return values and in error callbacks.
C++ error callback function type receiving asynchronous warnings/errors from RtAudio.

Primary C++ facade class providing a cross-API realtime audio I/O interface. It manages device enumeration, stream opening/closing, and runtime control. Nested types define API IDs, device info, and stream parameter/options structures.

objects.definition:
enum Api {
    UNSPECIFIED,
    MACOSX_CORE,
    LINUX_ALSA,
    UNIX_JACK,
    LINUX_PULSE,
    LINUX_OSS,
    WINDOWS_ASIO,
    WINDOWS_WASAPI,
    WINDOWS_DS,
    RTAUDIO_DUMMY,
    NUM_APIS
  };
objects.description: Enumeration of supported backend audio APIs selectable when constructing RtAudio and for introspection.
Struct describing an audio device's capabilities and current/default statuses as returned by queries.
Struct used to specify input/output stream device, channel count, and first channel when opening a stream.
Optional parameters controlling stream behavior such as flags, buffer count, client name, and realtime priority.
Platform-dependent typedef for a thread handle used internally for callback threads. On Windows it is uintptr_t; on POSIX it is pthread_t.
Platform-dependent typedef for a mutual exclusion primitive used to guard stream state. CRITICAL_SECTION on Windows, pthread_mutex_t on POSIX.
Internal struct used to shuttle callback-related state between RtApi stream internals and the global/OS callback layer.
Packed 24-bit signed integer helper class used for 24-bit sample conversion. Provides assignment from various types and conversion to 32-bit int via sign extension.

Abstract base class implementing backend-specific logic for RtAudio. Not directly constructed by users; RtAudio manages an RtApi subclass instance. Contains nested enums and internal structs for stream handling and conversion.

objects.definition: typedef unsigned long rtaudio_format_t;
objects.description: C-interface bitmask type mirroring RtAudioFormat for sample formats. Constants RTAUDIO_FORMAT_* defined in this header.

objects.definition: typedef unsigned int rtaudio_stream_flags_t;
objects.description: C-interface bitmask of stream option flags mirroring RtAudioStreamFlags.

objects.definition: typedef unsigned int rtaudio_stream_status_t;
objects.description: C-interface bitmask for stream over/underflow status flags.
C callback function pointer type for processing audio I/O in the C API.

objects.definition: typedef void (*rtaudio_error_cb_t)(rtaudio_error_t err, const char *msg);
objects.description: C error callback function pointer type receiving error code and message.

objects.definition:

C struct describing an audio device's capabilities and defaults for the C interface.
C struct specifying device and channel parameters for opening a stream.
C struct specifying stream flags, buffer count, realtime priority, and name for opening a stream.

objects.definition: typedef struct rtaudio *rtaudio_t;
objects.description: Opaque pointer handle to a C API RtAudio instance. The struct is intentionally not defined here; it wraps the C++ implementation.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getVersion
functions.description: Returns the current RtAudio version string (major.minor.patch, with optional beta). Intended for displaying or logging the library version at runtime.
requirements: None beyond being callable without an instance.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getCompiledApi
functions.description: Fills the provided vector with the list of audio APIs compiled into this RtAudio build. Used to discover available backends at runtime.
requirements: The reference parameter must be valid and writable.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getApiName
functions.description: Returns a stable, short, lower-case identifier string for the specified API. If the API is unknown, returns an empty string. Useful for programmatic selection or serialization.
requirements: Input api must be a valid RtAudio::Api enum value; unknown values yield an empty string.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getApiDisplayName
functions.description: Returns a human-readable display name for the specified API. If the API is unknown, returns an empty string. Useful for UI display.
requirements: Input api must be a valid RtAudio::Api enum value; unknown values yield an empty string.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getCompiledApiByName
functions.description: Returns the compiled API whose short name matches the given string (case-insensitive). On failure, returns UNSPECIFIED.
requirements: The name string should correspond to a compiled API short name; comparison is case-insensitive.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getCompiledApiByDisplayName
functions.description: Returns the compiled API whose display name exactly matches the given string (case-sensitive). On failure, returns UNSPECIFIED.
requirements: The name string must match an API display name exactly (case-sensitive) to succeed.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::RtAudio
functions.description: Constructs an RtAudio controller, selecting an available RtApi backend. If a specific API is requested but not compiled, a warning is issued and another available API is chosen; if none is available, construction aborts. An optional error callback can be provided to receive warnings and errors.
requirements: If api is specified, it should be one of the compiled APIs, otherwise a warning is emitted and another API may be selected.
If provided, errorCallback must remain valid callable target for the lifetime of the RtAudio instance.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::~RtAudio
functions.description: Destructor. Ensures any running/open stream is stopped and closed automatically, then releases resources.
requirements: Do not use the object after destruction.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getCurrentApi
functions.description: Returns the audio API in use by this RtAudio instance.
requirements: Instance must have been successfully constructed.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getDeviceCount
functions.description: Queries the system for the number of available audio devices. Performs a fresh probe each call; devices connected/disconnected after instantiation are reflected. Issues a warning on system error.
requirements: None; may return 0 if no devices are available.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getDeviceIds
functions.description: Returns a vector of RtAudio device IDs from a fresh system query. These IDs are internal to RtAudio and not API-native IDs. Vector size will be zero if no devices are available. Issues a warning on system error.
requirements: Use returned IDs only with RtAudio APIs (they are not native device IDs).

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getDeviceNames
functions.description: Returns a vector of device names from a fresh system query. Vector is empty if no devices are found. Issues a warning on system error.
requirements: None.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getDeviceInfo
functions.description: Returns a DeviceInfo struct for the specified RtAudio device ID. If the ID is invalid (e.g., device removed), an RTAUDIO_INVALID_USE is reported and a default-initialized DeviceInfo is returned. Flags indicate default input/output device status when applicable.
requirements: deviceId must be a value previously returned by getDeviceIds() and still valid (device not removed).

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getDefaultOutputDevice
functions.description: Returns the RtAudio ID of the default output device. If the backend lacks a default, returns the first probed output device. Returns 0 if no devices are available.
requirements: None; 0 indicates no valid device.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getDefaultInputDevice
functions.description: Returns the RtAudio ID of the default input device. If the backend lacks a default, returns the first probed input device. Returns 0 if no devices are available.
requirements: None; 0 indicates no valid device.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::openStream
functions.signature: rt::audio::RtAudioErrorType rt::audio::RtAudio::openStream(rt::audio::RtAudio::StreamParameters *outputParameters, rt::audio::RtAudio::StreamParameters *inputParameters, rt::audio::RtAudioFormat format, unsigned int sampleRate, unsigned int *bufferFrames, rt::audio::RtAudioCallback callback, void *userData = NULL, rt::audio::RtAudio::StreamOptions *options = NULL)
functions.description: Opens an audio stream with the specified input/output parameters, format, sample rate, and buffer size, and registers a user callback for I/O. Returns RTAUDIO_SYSTEM_ERROR on failure to open/process, or RTAUDIO_INVALID_USE if parameters are invalid or a stream is already open. On success, may adjust bufferFrames to the actual size and options fields to actual values. Supports various stream flags via options to control interleaving, latency, exclusive access, realtime scheduling, ALSA default device, and JACK auto-connect.
requirements: If opening output-only streams, inputParameters must be NULL; for input-only streams, outputParameters must be NULL. For duplex streams, both may be non-NULL.
outputParameters->deviceId and/or inputParameters->deviceId must be values returned by getDeviceIds().
outputParameters->nChannels/inputParameters->nChannels specify the number of channels; firstChannel selects the starting channel index (default 0).
format must be one of RTAUDIO_SINT8/16/24/32, RTAUDIO_FLOAT32/64.
sampleRate is the desired sample frames per second; actual rate may differ slightly depending on the system.
bufferFrames must be a valid pointer; on input it requests desired frames per buffer (0 to auto-select); on return it contains actual frames per buffer.
callback must be a valid callable matching RtAudioCallback and must follow the return convention: 0=continue, 1=stop and drain, 2=abort immediately.
userData is optional and passed to the callback as provided.
If options is provided, its flags/numberOfBuffers/priority/streamName may influence the stream; actual values used may be modified on return.
Function must be called when no stream is currently open on this instance.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::closeStream
functions.description: Closes the currently open stream and frees associated resources. If no stream is open, an RTAUDIO_WARNING is emitted.
requirements: Safe to call if a stream is open or closed; when closed, any running stream should be stopped by the implementation.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::startStream
functions.description: Starts the previously opened stream. Returns RTAUDIO_SYSTEM_ERROR on processing error; returns RTAUDIO_WARNING if the stream is not open or is already running.
requirements: A stream must have been successfully opened and be not already running.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::stopStream
functions.description: Stops the stream, allowing queued output samples to be played (drain). Returns RTAUDIO_SYSTEM_ERROR on processing error; returns RTAUDIO_WARNING if the stream is not open or already stopped.
requirements: A stream must be open; has no effect if already stopped aside from returning a warning.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::abortStream
functions.description: Immediately stops the stream and discards any queued input/output samples. Returns RTAUDIO_SYSTEM_ERROR on processing error; returns RTAUDIO_WARNING if the stream is not open or already stopped.
requirements: A stream should be open; calling when stopped or not open yields a warning.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getErrorText
functions.description: Retrieves the detailed error or warning message corresponding to the last non-zero RtAudioErrorType returned by any method. Same message as sent to the error callback, if set.
requirements: Call after a method returns a non-zero RtAudioErrorType to obtain details.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::isStreamOpen
functions.description: Returns true if a stream is currently open, otherwise false.
requirements: None.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::isStreamRunning
functions.description: Returns true if a stream is open and running, false if stopped or not open.
requirements: None.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getStreamTime
functions.description: Returns the number of seconds of audio processed since the stream was started. Increments in buffer-size quanta; not an absolute wall-clock. If no stream is open, the returned value may be invalid.
requirements: Call when a stream is open for meaningful values.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::setStreamTime
functions.description: Sets the stream time counter to a value in seconds greater than or equal to 0.0.
requirements: time must be >= 0.0.
A stream should be open for the setting to take effect on the current stream state.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getStreamLatency
functions.description: Returns the internal stream latency in sample frames (sum of input and output latencies for duplex). If no stream is open, the value will be invalid. If the API does not report latency, returns 0.
requirements: Call on an open stream to get meaningful latency.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::getStreamSampleRate
functions.description: Returns the actual sample rate in use by the open stream. If no stream is open, returns 0.
requirements: A stream should be open to get a non-zero value.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::setErrorCallback
functions.description: Registers a callback invoked when an error or warning occurs inside RtAudio methods.
requirements: errorCallback must be a valid callable; it should remain valid for as long as the RtAudio instance may invoke it.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtAudio::showWarnings
functions.description: Enables or disables output of warning messages. If an error callback is set, warnings go to it; otherwise to stderr.
requirements: None.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::RtApi
functions.description: Base-class constructor for API-specific implementations. Initializes internal state. Not directly instantiable in practice since RtApi is abstract.
requirements: Called by derived classes; not for direct use.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::~RtApi
functions.description: Virtual destructor for the base class; cleans up internal resources and ensures derived cleanup via virtual dispatch.
requirements: None.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::getCurrentApi
functions.description: Pure virtual. Returns the API implemented by the derived RtApi instance (e.g., ALSA, JACK, CoreAudio).
requirements: Must be implemented by each derived RtApi backend.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::getDeviceCount
functions.description: Queries and returns the number of available audio devices for this backend. Performs probing if needed; may emit warnings on errors.
requirements: None.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::getDeviceIds
functions.description: Returns a vector of backend-agnostic RtAudio device IDs discovered for this backend. IDs are stable for current probe but are not backend-native IDs.
requirements: Use only with RtAudio APIs.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::getDeviceNames
functions.description: Returns a vector of device names discovered for this backend.
requirements: None.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::getDeviceInfo
functions.description: Returns DeviceInfo for the given RtAudio device ID, or default/invalid if the ID is invalid. May emit an RTAUDIO_INVALID_USE.
requirements: deviceId must be one obtained from getDeviceIds() and still valid.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::getDefaultInputDevice
functions.description: Returns the RtAudio ID of the default input device for this backend. Default implementation provided; backends may override.
requirements: None; returns 0 if no devices.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::getDefaultOutputDevice
functions.description: Returns the RtAudio ID of the default output device for this backend. Default implementation provided; backends may override.
requirements: None; returns 0 if no devices.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::openStream
functions.signature: rt::audio::RtAudioErrorType rt::audio::RtApi::openStream(rt::audio::RtAudio::StreamParameters *outputParameters, rt::audio::RtAudio::StreamParameters *inputParameters, rt::audio::RtAudioFormat format, unsigned int sampleRate, unsigned int *bufferFrames, rt::audio::RtAudioCallback callback, void *userData, rt::audio::RtAudio::StreamOptions *options)
functions.description: Backend-level implementation to open a stream with given parameters and register the callback. On failure, returns RTAUDIO_SYSTEM_ERROR; returns RTAUDIO_INVALID_USE if a stream is already open or parameters are invalid. May modify bufferFrames/options to realized values.
requirements: Same as RtAudio::openStream: mutually exclusive NULL for input/output to select direction; valid device IDs from getDeviceIds(); channel counts and firstChannel indices per device capabilities; non-null bufferFrames pointer; valid callback with correct return semantics; options optional.
Must be called when no stream is open for this RtApi instance.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::closeStream
functions.description: Closes an open stream and frees resources. Emits a warning if no stream is open (handled by error callback or stderr).
requirements: Safe to call regardless of stream state.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::startStream
functions.description: Pure virtual. Starts the open stream for the backend. Returns errors/warnings consistent with RtAudio::startStream().
requirements: An open stream must exist; derived classes must implement start logic.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::stopStream
functions.description: Pure virtual. Stops the stream, allowing output drain. Returns errors/warnings consistent with RtAudio::stopStream().
requirements: Derived classes must implement stop logic; an open stream should exist.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::abortStream
functions.description: Pure virtual. Immediately stops the stream and discards queued samples. Returns errors/warnings consistent with RtAudio::abortStream().
requirements: Derived classes must implement abort logic; an open stream should exist.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::getErrorText
functions.description: Returns the last error/warning message text for this RtApi instance.
requirements: Call after a non-zero error code is encountered for details.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::getStreamLatency
functions.description: Returns the internal stream latency in frames (sum of input/output for duplex). Returns 0 if the API does not report latency; invalid if no stream open.
requirements: Call when a stream is open for meaningful value.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::getStreamSampleRate
functions.description: Returns the actual sample rate currently in use by the open stream; returns 0 if not open.
requirements: Stream should be open to get a non-zero value.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::getStreamTime
functions.description: Returns seconds of processed audio since stream start for this backend. Default implementation returns internal counter.
requirements: Stream should be open for meaningful value.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::setStreamTime
functions.description: Sets the internal stream time counter to a non-negative value.
requirements: time must be >= 0.0.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::isStreamOpen
functions.description: Returns true if a stream is open for this backend, false otherwise.
requirements: None.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::isStreamRunning
functions.description: Returns true if a stream is running for this backend.
requirements: None.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::setErrorCallback
functions.description: Registers an error callback to receive warnings and errors produced by this backend instance.
requirements: errorCallback must be a valid callable; should remain valid while the backend may invoke it.

functions.name: rt::audio::RtApi::showWarnings
functions.description: Enables/disables emission of warning messages by this backend instance.
requirements: None.

functions.name: rtaudio_version
functions.description: C API: Returns a pointer to a static string with the current RtAudio version.
requirements: Return is static; do not free.

functions.name: rtaudio_get_num_compiled_apis
functions.description: C API: Returns the count of compiled audio APIs; length of the array returned by rtaudio_compiled_api().
requirements: None.

functions.name: rtaudio_compiled_api
functions.description: C API: Returns a pointer to a static array of compiled APIs; length is given by rtaudio_get_num_compiled_apis().
requirements: Returned array is static; do not free.
Caller must use rtaudio_get_num_compiled_apis() to know the array length.

functions.name: rtaudio_api_name
functions.description: C API: Returns a short identifier name for the given API, or empty string if unknown.
requirements: api should be a valid rtaudio_api_t; unknown yields empty string.

functions.name: rtaudio_api_display_name
functions.description: C API: Returns a display name for the given API, or empty string if unknown.
requirements: api should be a valid rtaudio_api_t; unknown yields empty string.

functions.name: rtaudio_compiled_api_by_name
functions.description: C API: Returns the compiled API whose short name matches the given string (case-insensitive). Returns RTAUDIO_API_UNSPECIFIED on failure.
requirements: name must point to a null-terminated string; comparison is case-insensitive.

functions.name: rtaudio_error
functions.description: C API: Returns a pointer to a string describing the last error/warning for the given RtAudio instance.
requirements: audio must be a valid rtaudio_t created by rtaudio_create().
Returned pointer remains valid until the next error change; do not free.

functions.name: rtaudio_error_type
functions.description: C API: Returns the last error code for the given RtAudio instance.
requirements: audio must be a valid rtaudio_t.

functions.name: rtaudio_create
functions.description: C API: Creates an RtAudio instance targeting the specified API (or unspecified to auto-select) and returns an opaque handle.
requirements: api should be one of rtaudio_api_t values; if the specified API is unavailable, another may be selected per library behavior.
Returned handle must be destroyed with rtaudio_destroy().

functions.name: rtaudio_destroy
functions.description: C API: Destroys an RtAudio instance created by rtaudio_create() and releases its resources.
requirements: audio must be a handle previously returned by rtaudio_create(); after destruction the handle must not be used.

functions.name: rtaudio_current_api
functions.description: C API: Returns the API in current use by the given RtAudio instance.
requirements: audio must be a valid handle.

functions.name: rtaudio_device_count
functions.description: C API: Returns the number of audio devices currently available for this instance's backend. Fresh probe each call; may be 0.
requirements: audio must be valid.

functions.name: rtaudio_get_device_id
functions.signature: RTAUDIOAPI unsigned int rtaudio_get_device_id(rtaudio_t audio, int i)
functions.description: C API: Returns the RtAudio device ID for the device at index i (0..count-1). Returns 0 if out-of-bounds or if no devices are found.
requirements: audio must be valid.
i must be in [0, rtaudio_device_count(audio) - 1] for a valid non-zero ID.

functions.name: rtaudio_get_device_info
functions.signature: RTAUDIOAPI rtaudio_device_info_t rtaudio_get_device_info(rtaudio_t audio, unsigned int id)
functions.description: C API: Returns device information for the specified RtAudio device ID. On invalid ID, returns a struct with default/invalid fields and sets an error internally.
requirements: audio must be valid.
id must be a device ID returned by rtaudio_get_device_id() or from the current probe and still valid.

functions.name: rtaudio_get_default_output_device
functions.description: C API: Returns the RtAudio device ID of the default output device (or first probed output device if no default). Returns 0 if none.
requirements: audio must be valid.

functions.name: rtaudio_get_default_input_device
functions.description: C API: Returns the RtAudio device ID of the default input device (or first probed input device if no default). Returns 0 if none.
requirements: audio must be valid.

functions.name: rtaudio_open_stream
functions.signature: RTAUDIOAPI rtaudio_error_t rtaudio_open_stream(rtaudio_t audio, rtaudio_stream_parameters_t *output_params, rtaudio_stream_parameters_t *input_params, rtaudio_format_t format, unsigned int sample_rate, unsigned int *buffer_frames, rtaudio_cb_t cb, void *userdata, rtaudio_stream_options_t *options, rtaudio_error_cb_t errcb)
functions.description: C API: Opens a stream with the specified parameters and registers a user callback for I/O. On success, may modify buffer_frames/options to actual values. Returns a rtaudio_error code: non-zero on failure or invalid use. An optional error callback can be provided to receive warnings/errors.
requirements: audio must be a valid handle with no stream currently open.
For output-only streams, input_params must be NULL; for input-only streams, output_params must be NULL; for duplex, both may be non-NULL.
output_params->device_id and/or input_params->device_id must be valid IDs obtained from this instance.
{output,input}_params->num_channels > 0 and first_channel selects starting device channel (default 0).
format must be one of RTAUDIO_FORMAT_* constants.
sample_rate is desired frames per second; actual used rate may differ slightly.
buffer_frames must be a valid pointer; input 0 to auto-select; output contains actual frames per buffer.
cb must be a valid function pointer and must adhere to return codes: 0=continue, 1=stop+drain, 2=abort.
userdata is optional and passed to cb as-is.
options is optional; may affect flags/num_buffers/priority/name; actual used values may be written back.
errcb is optional; if provided, must be a valid function pointer for error notifications.

functions.name: rtaudio_close_stream
functions.description: C API: Closes the current stream and frees resources. Emits a warning if no stream is open (delivered via error callback or stderr).
requirements: audio must be a valid handle.

functions.name: rtaudio_start_stream
functions.description: C API: Starts the previously opened stream. Returns error codes on processing error or warning if not open/already running.
requirements: audio must be valid and have an open stream not already running.

functions.name: rtaudio_stop_stream
functions.description: C API: Stops the stream, allowing output to drain. Returns error codes on processing error or warning if not open/already stopped.
requirements: audio must be valid; stream should be open.

functions.name: rtaudio_abort_stream
functions.description: C API: Immediately stops the stream and discards queued samples. Returns error codes or warning if not open/already stopped.
requirements: audio must be valid; stream should be open.

functions.name: rtaudio_is_stream_open
functions.description: C API: Returns 1 if a stream is open, 0 otherwise.
requirements: audio must be valid.

functions.name: rtaudio_is_stream_running
functions.description: C API: Returns 1 if a stream is running, 0 if stopped or not open.
requirements: audio must be valid.

functions.name: rtaudio_get_stream_time
functions.description: C API: Returns seconds of processed audio since stream start; increments in buffer-sized steps. May be invalid if no stream open.
requirements: audio must be valid; call when stream is open for meaningful value.

functions.name: rtaudio_set_stream_time
functions.signature: RTAUDIOAPI void rtaudio_set_stream_time(rtaudio_t audio, double time)
functions.description: C API: Sets the stream time counter to a non-negative number of seconds.
requirements: audio must be valid.
time must be >= 0.0.

functions.name: rtaudio_get_stream_latency
functions.description: C API: Returns internal stream latency in frames (sum of input/output for duplex). Returns 0 if the API does not report latency; invalid if not open.
requirements: audio must be valid; call on an open stream for meaningful value.

functions.name: rtaudio_get_stream_sample_rate
functions.description: C API: Returns the actual sample rate in use by the open stream; returns 0 if not open.
requirements: audio must be valid; stream should be open.

functions.description: C API: Enables (non-zero) or disables (zero) emission of warning messages for this instance.
requirements: audio must be valid.

data_types.description: Arbitrary byte string treated as a general text identifier. May contain any characters, including non-ASCII and null bytes (though typical API expects readable names). Used for matching against API names; comparison may be case-insensitive or case-sensitive depending on function.

generators.generator:
import random
import string
from typing import List

# This generator targets APIs that expect a string naming an RtAudio backend.
# Interesting valid inputs include known short names and display names, in
# various casings and with surrounding noise, as well as edge cases like empty
# strings and strings containing embedded NULs (for FUZZ_PARAM_STR) and
# non-ASCII UTF-8. The buffer returned here will be consumed by the fuzzer's
# FUZZ_PARAM_STR / c_str() usages. We ensure size <= 4096 bytes.

KNOWN_SHORT_NAMES = [
    # Canonical short identifiers used by RtAudio C/C++ APIs
    "core",        # MACOSX_CORE
    "alsa",        # LINUX_ALSA
    "jack",        # UNIX_JACK
    "pulse",       # LINUX_PULSE
    "oss",         # LINUX_OSS
    "asio",        # WINDOWS_ASIO
    "wasapi",      # WINDOWS_WASAPI
    "ds",          # WINDOWS_DS
    "dummy",       # RTAUDIO_DUMMY
    "unspecified", # UNSPECIFIED
]

KNOWN_DISPLAY_NAMES = [
    # Human-readable display names typically returned by RtAudio
    "CoreAudio",
    "ALSA",
    "JACK",
    "PulseAudio",
    "OSS",
    "ASIO",
    "WASAPI",
    "DirectSound",
    "Dummy",
    "Unspecified",
]

UNICODE_SAMPLES = [
    "Áudio",           # accented
    "音频",             # Chinese
    "オーディオ",         # Japanese
    "аудио",           # Cyrillic
    "صوت",             # Arabic (RTL)
    "ऑडियो",           # Devanagari
    "💽🎧",            # emoji
]

SURROUND_NOISE = [
    "", " ", "\t", "\n", "::", "[]", "{}", "()", "--", "##", "@@",
]


def _rand_case(s: str, rnd: random.Random) -> str:
    # Randomly vary case to exercise case-insensitive matching paths
    out = []
    for ch in s:
        if ch.isalpha() and rnd.random() < 0.6:
            out.append(ch.upper() if rnd.random() < 0.5 else ch.lower())
        else:
            out.append(ch)
    return ''.join(out)


def _maybe_embed_nul(s: bytes, rnd: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Occasionally embed NULs for FUZZ_PARAM_STR callers (std::string may hold NULs);
    # For c_str() use, only prefix before first NUL is read, still interesting.
    if not s:
        return s
    if rnd.random() < 0.25:
        pos = rnd.randrange(0, len(s) + 1)
        return s[:pos] + b"\x00" + s[pos:]
    return s


def _build_candidate(rnd: random.Random) -> str:
    mode = rnd.choices(
        population=[
            "short_exact",     # exact known short name
            "short_cased",     # short name with random casing
            "display_exact",   # exact display name (case-sensitive path)
            "display_noise",   # display name with surrounding noise (may fail match)
            "short_noise",     # short name with surrounding noise (may fail match)
            "unknown_like",    # plausible unknown token
            "unicode",         # non-ASCII
            "empty",           # empty string
            "long_padding",    # long but within cap
        ],
        weights=[20, 15, 15, 10, 10, 10, 8, 6, 6],
        k=1,
    )[0]

    if mode == "short_exact":
        return rnd.choice(KNOWN_SHORT_NAMES)
    if mode == "short_cased":
        return _rand_case(rnd.choice(KNOWN_SHORT_NAMES), rnd)
    if mode == "display_exact":
        return rnd.choice(KNOWN_DISPLAY_NAMES)
    if mode == "display_noise":
        core = rnd.choice(KNOWN_DISPLAY_NAMES)
        pre = rnd.choice(SURROUND_NOISE) * rnd.randint(0, 2)
        post = rnd.choice(SURROUND_NOISE) * rnd.randint(0, 2)
        return f"{pre}{core}{post}"
    if mode == "short_noise":
        core = _rand_case(rnd.choice(KNOWN_SHORT_NAMES), rnd)
        pre = rnd.choice(SURROUND_NOISE) * rnd.randint(0, 2)
        post = rnd.choice(SURROUND_NOISE) * rnd.randint(0, 2)
        return f"{pre}{core}{post}"
    if mode == "unknown_like":
        # Construct tokens that look like API names but aren't valid
        tokens = [
            "alsa2", "pulseaudio", "jackd", "winmm", "coreaudiox", "wasapi-ex",
            "directsound", "wavert", "pa_wasapi", "audiounit",
        ]
        base = rnd.choice(tokens)
        # Possibly add separators or digits
        sep = rnd.choice(["", "_", "-", "/"]) if rnd.random() < 0.7 else ""
        suffix = ''.join(rnd.choice(string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits) for _ in range(rnd.randint(0, 3)))
        return _rand_case(base + sep + suffix, rnd)
    if mode == "unicode":
        core = rnd.choice(UNICODE_SAMPLES)
        # Optionally mix with a valid token to sometimes pass/ sometimes fail
        if rnd.random() < 0.5:
            core = core + " " + _rand_case(rnd.choice(KNOWN_DISPLAY_NAMES + KNOWN_SHORT_NAMES), rnd)
        return core
    if mode == "empty":
        return ""
    if mode == "long_padding":
        # Build a long but capped string that starts with a valid token to still hit matches
        head = rnd.choice(KNOWN_SHORT_NAMES + KNOWN_DISPLAY_NAMES)
        pad_chars = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "_-:/ "+"\t"
        pad = ''.join(rnd.choice(pad_chars) for _ in range(rnd.randint(50, 200)))
        if rnd.random() < 0.5:
            s = head + pad
        else:
            s = pad + head
        return s[:256]
    return ""


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rnd = random.Random(seed)

    # Generate between 1 and 3 candidate strings and join with newline. Each stub
    # will typically pull only one FUZZ_PARAM_STR, but concatenation keeps inputs
    # interesting for setups that split by lines.
    parts: List[str] = []
    count = rnd.randint(1, 3)
    for _ in range(count):
        parts.append(_build_candidate(rnd))
    s = "\n".join(parts)

    # Ensure max length <= 4096 and also within the stub-imposed 256 cap per string.
    # We keep overall <= 1024 for safety; individual strings may already be <=256.
    s = s[:1024]

    data = s.encode('utf-8', errors='surrogatepass')
    data = _maybe_embed_nul(data, rnd)

    # Final cap to 4096 bytes as required
    return data[:4096]
